correctness.rationale: By the complement definition, the total 2-cut complex is Alexander dual to L=Cl(C_n^p); combinatorial Alexander duality twists rational homology by ambient permutation sign ε_n and shifts by n-i-3. Adamaszek clique classification gives a single nonzero degree, with wedge rank m-1 in critical m|p, else one sphere. For rotation r^a, cyclic orbit length t even precludes a fixed nonempty clique, while odd t reduces invariant cliques to C_h^P with h=gcd(n,a) and P=p-(t-1)h/2; h-2P=m. The signed reduced Lefschetz trace is m-1 exactly for m|p and m|a and otherwise -1. Multiplying degree sign yields inflated C_m augmentation character in critical case, or trivial clique character in noncritical, both twisted by ε_n. Rational quotient homology is the invariants: rank one iff (noncritical and n odd) or (critical and m even). An independent direct exhaustive clique-orbit trace enumerator verified 364 rotation tests across p=3..8, not universal proof.

originality.rationale: The 2011 cyclic clique-complex homotopy theorem supplies the sphere-degree premise; Chauhan–Shukla–Vinayak and Carnero Bravo give total cut complexes nonequivariant topology. Adamaszek–Adams–Frick–Peterson–Previte-Johnson treat rotation representations of circular-arc nerve complexes, but their clique/nerve homotopy equivalences change the cyclic vertex set and do not canonically intertwine original one-step C_n rotations. A published cycle-power three-cut cyclic-character theorem is a different cut construction and parameter range. Thus no inspected stronger prior result mathematically implies this exact C_n-module and quotient criterion.
